name: Your Name
title: Angular Frontend Developer
summary: Frontend-focused Software Developer with 5 years of experience building scalable web applications using Angular, TypeScript and JavaScript, with hands-on exposure to Node.js, REST APIs and backend development.

bullets: Developed and maintained scalable web applications for Proveera Exports and ThriveHealth using Angular, ensuring a user-centric approach.
Built and optimized CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions for automated testing and deployment, enhancing efficiency across multiple Angular projects.
Designed responsive user interfaces with Tailwind CSS and Angular Material, ensuring brand consistency and an intuitive user experience.
Integrated RESTful APIs into Angular applications using HttpClient, enhancing data communication, and implemented strong error handling and authentication workflows.
Improved application performance and SEO by establishing server-side rendering (SSR) with Angular Universal.
Gained foundational knowledge in server-side development with Node.js, including RESTful API creation and managing dependencies through npm.

projects.name: Sketchplay
bullets: Developed and maintained Sketchplay, a comprehensive sports tournament management platform enabling organizers to create, schedule, and run tournaments end-to-end.
Built features for team/player registration, payment collection (including pay-later and installment options), and invoice tracking across the full tournament lifecycle.
Implemented tournament scheduling tools including pool play, bracket generation, and game-day management for organizers and coaches.
Delivered admin tools for managing rosters, tracking registrations, and communicating with participants across multiple tournaments and organizations.

projects.name: Voice Agents
bullets: Developed an AI-powered voice booking assistant for a client that enhances customer engagement through natural conversations.
Streamlined appointment scheduling by automating call responses, significantly reducing missed calls and scheduling conflicts.
Implemented features tailored for diverse industries, including salons, restaurants, healthcare, and service-based businesses, improving operational efficiency.
Conducted user testing and gathered feedback to refine the assistant's performance, ensuring high user satisfaction and adaptability.

projects.name: Proveera Exports
bullets: Developed Proveera Exports, a mobile and web-based platform focused on quality exports.
Ensured top-quality products and timely fulfillment to enhance overall customer experience.
Collaborated with industry experts to leverage over a decade of experience in the export sector.
Implemented best-in-class product delivery methods to achieve complete customer satisfaction.
Streamlined order placement, shipment, and delivery processes for efficiency through professional support and a structured system.

projects.name: ThriveHealth
bullets: Developed and implemented ThriveHealth, an integrated platform designed for healthcare job placements.
Created a user-friendly healthcare job portal enabling facilities to post job openings and manage shifts efficiently.
Designed features allowing nurses to apply for shifts, track attendance, and manage their timesheets seamlessly.
Engineered a web portal that empowers healthcare facilities to create job listings and oversee timesheet approvals effectively.
Focused on enhancing user experience and operational efficiency, supporting the healthcare sector's staffing needs from August 2022 to August 2024.
